searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Account ids. It is a required field if the -guarantor or patient fields are not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The entity that caused the expenses. It is a required field if the _id or -guarantor fields are not given. Must be set with identifier.

searchParam.name: -encounter
searchParam.documentation: The encounter associated with the resource.

searchParam.name: -guarantor
searchParam.documentation: The entity that responsible for payment. It is a required field if the _id or patient fields are not given.

searchParam.name: type
searchParam.documentation: The identifier for the account. Required in every search request.

searchParam.name: identifier
searchParam.documentation: Statement Account number. Must be set with patients

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. Not honored when '_id' is set.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of AllergyIntolerance ids. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: Who the sensitivity is for. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: clinical-status
searchParam.documentation: Certainty of the allergy or intolerance.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range used to search for AllergyIntolerance records which were last updated in that period. The '_lastUpdated' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for AllergyIntolerance records at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes to search for AllergyIntolerance records within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Appointment ids. Either the '_id' parameter or one of the 'patient', 'practitioner' or 'location' parameters must be set.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. Not honored when '_id' is set.

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range from which to find appointments. This or the '-date-or-req-period' parameter must be set when using patient, practitioner or location. The 'date' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for appointments at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le' and 'gt' prefixes to search for appointments within a specific range. The date prefix pair must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: -date-or-req-period
searchParam.documentation: A start date or requested period from which to find appointments. This or the 'date' parameter must be set when using patient, practitioner or location. The '-date-or-req-period' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for appointments at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le' and 'gt' prefixes to search for appointments within a specific range. The date prefix pair must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: One of the individuals of the appointment is this patient. Either the '_id' parameter or one of the 'patient', 'practitioner' or 'location' parameters must be set.

searchParam.name: practitioner
searchParam.documentation: One of the individuals of the appointment is this practitioner. Either the '_id' parameter or one of the 'patient', 'practitioner' or 'location' parameters must be set.

searchParam.name: location
searchParam.documentation: This location is listed in the participants of the appointment. Either the '_id' parameter or one of the 'patient', 'practitioner' or 'location' parameters must be set.

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: The overall status of the appointment.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of CarePlan ids.

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: A date range with which to find CarePlans. If used, the ‘date’ parameter must be provided twice. Once with a 'ge' prefix representing the earliest date, and once with a 'le’ prefix representing the latest date. The date prefix pair must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: Who the careplan is for. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: category
searchParam.documentation: The category of the careplan. Category assess-plan is supported as of now.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return. Not honored when '_id' is set.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: CareTeam id supports only the single id. It is a required field if the patient or encounter fields are not given.

searchParam.name: category
searchParam.documentation: The category of the careteam. Category Longitudinal (patient level) or Encounter is supported as of now.

searchParam.name: encounter
searchParam.documentation: The Encounter level CareTeam are displayed.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: Who the careteam is for. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: The status of the CareTeam.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: ChargeItem id supports only the single id. It is a required field if the account or context fields are not given.

searchParam.name: context
searchParam.documentation: Encounter associated with the ChargeItem. If provided, the '-status' parameter must also be provided. It is a required field if the _id or account fields are not given.

searchParam.name: account
searchParam.documentation: Account associated with the ChargeItem. If provided, the '-status' parameter must also be provided. It is a required field if the _id or context fields are not given.

searchParam.name: -status
searchParam.documentation: The status of the ChargeItem. Must be set to 'billable'. Must be provided with the context and account parameter.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. Not honored when '_id' is set.

operation.name: credit
operation.documentation: Creates an offsetting ChargeItem for an existing debit ChargeItem.

operation.name: modify
operation.documentation: Modifies an existing ChargeItem resulting in a newly created ChargeItem.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Communication ids. It is a required field if the category, -email-status, received and recipient fields are not given.

searchParam.name: category
searchParam.documentation: The message category. It is a required field if the _id field is not given. Must be set with received, recipient and -email-status.

searchParam.name: received
searchParam.documentation: When the message is received. It is a required field if the _id field is not given. Must be set with category, recipient and -email-status. If used, the ‘received’ parameter may be provided once or twice. Once with a 'ge' prefix representing the earliest received date, and/or once with a 'le’ prefix representing the latest received date.

searchParam.name: recipient
searchParam.documentation: The recipient of the message. It is a required field if the _id field is not given. Must be set with category, recipient and -email-status.

searchParam.name: -email-status
searchParam.documentation: The email status of the message. It is a required field if the _id field is not given. Must be set with category, received and recipient.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Condition ids. It is a required field if the patient or subject fields are not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: Who has the condition. It is a required field if the subject or _id fields are not given.

searchParam.name: encounter
searchParam.documentation: The encounter of the patient. Only encounter-diagnosis are returned.

searchParam.name: subject
searchParam.documentation: Who has the condition. It is a required field if the patient or _id fields are not given.

searchParam.name: clinical-status
searchParam.documentation: The clinical status of the condition.

searchParam.name: category
searchParam.documentation: The category of the condition. Categories problem-list-item, encounter-diagnosis and health-concern are supported as of now.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range used to search for conditions which were last updated in that period. The '_lastUpdated' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for Conditions at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes to search for conditions report within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Consent ids.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: Who the consent applies to. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: actor
searchParam.documentation: Resource for the actor (or group, by role). It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient.identifier
searchParam.documentation: The patient.identifier allows to search by patient aliases. Federated Person Principle, SSN, MRN etc... are supported as of now. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: actor.identifier
searchParam.documentation: The actor.identifier allows to search by related person aliases. Federated Person Principle is the only supported alias as of now. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: Retrieve coverages for a patient.

searchParam.name: -encounter
searchParam.documentation: Retrieve coverages for an encounter.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Device ids. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient to whom Device is affixed. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of DiagnosticReport ids. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: category
searchParam.documentation: Which diagnostic discipline/department created the report.

searchParam.name: code
searchParam.documentation: The code for the report.

searchParam.name: encounter
searchParam.documentation: The Encounter when the report was made.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The subject of the report. It is a required field.

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: A date range with which to find Documents. A date parameter may be provided once with or without prefix and time component to imply a date range. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt'  prefixes and time component to search for procedures within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range. Must be set with patient or subject.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range used to search for Documents of diagnostic report which were last updated in that period. The '_lastUpdated' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for Documents of diagnostic report at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes to search for Documents of diagnostic report within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of DocumentReference ids. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient the document is about. It is a required field if the subject field is not given.

searchParam.name: encounter
searchParam.documentation: The Encounter in which the document was created.

searchParam.name: period
searchParam.documentation: A date range with which to find Documents. If used, the 'period' parameter must be provided twice. Once with a 'ge' prefix representing the earliest date, and once with a 'lt' prefix representing the latest date. The period prefix pair must create a closed range and cannot be equal to each other.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page.

searchParam.name: type
searchParam.documentation: The kind of document (LOINC if possible).

searchParam.name: category
searchParam.documentation: The categorization of document.

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: It must be provided  once with a prefix to imply a date  range or without a prefix to search for document(s) at a specific date. Alternately it may be provided twice with `le`, `lt`, `ge`, or `gt` prefixes to search for document(s) within specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range. For a single 'date' occurrence, `time` component is optional but for two `date` occurrences, must include `time` component.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range used to search for Documents which were last updated in that period. The '_lastUpdated' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for Documents at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes to search for Documents within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Encounter ids. It is a required field if the account or identifier or -pageContext or patient or subject fields are not given.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. Not honored when '_id' is set.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient present at the encounter. It is a required field if the account or _id or identifier or -pageContext or subject fields are not given.

searchParam.name: subject
searchParam.documentation: The patient present at the encounter. It is a required field if the account or _id or identifier or -pageContext or patient fields are not given.

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: The status of the encounter. Must be set with patient.

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: A date parameter may be provided once with a prefix and time component to imply a date range. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes and time component to search for encounters within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range. Must be set with patient or subject.

searchParam.name: identifier
searchParam.documentation: An encounter's identifier. It is a required field if the account or _id or -pageContext or patient or subject fields are not given.

searchParam.name: account
searchParam.documentation: The account associated with the encounters. This parameter is required if patient, subject, _id, or identifier is not used.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range used to search for Encounter records which were last updated in that period. The '_lastUpdated' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for Encounter records at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes to search for Encounter records within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of FamilyMemberHistory ids. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: Who the family member history is for. It is a required field if the _id field is not given. It is a required field if the status parameter is provided.

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: The status of the FamilyMemberHistory.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: Goal id supports only the single id. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: Who has the goal is for. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: target-date
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range from which to find Goals.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Immunization ids. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient for the vaccination record. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: Vaccination LastUpdated Date.

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: Vaccination (non)-Administration Date.

searchParam.name: target-disease
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of target diseases the dose is being administered against.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of InsurancePlan ids.

searchParam.name: owned-by
searchParam.documentation: The organization that is providing the health insurance product.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Location ids. It is a required field if the -physicalType field is not given

searchParam.name: -physicalType
searchParam.documentation: The Location's physical type. It is a required field if the _id field is not given

searchParam.name: identifier
searchParam.documentation: A location's identifier.

searchParam.name: address
searchParam.documentation: A (part of the) address of the location

searchParam.name: address-city
searchParam.documentation: A city specified in an address. It is a required field if the address-state or address-postalcode fields are not given

searchParam.name: address-state
searchParam.documentation: A state specified in an address

searchParam.name: address-postalcode
searchParam.documentation: A postal code specified in an address

searchParam.name: name
searchParam.documentation: A portion of the location's name or alias

searchParam.name: organization
searchParam.documentation: Searches for locations that are managed by the provided organization

searchParam.name: type
searchParam.documentation: The Location's type. It is a required field if the _id field is not given

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of MedicationAdministration ids.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The identity of a patient to list administrations for. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: MedicationAdministration event status.

searchParam.name: performer
searchParam.documentation: The identity of the individual who administered the medication.

searchParam.name: effective-time
searchParam.documentation: A effective-time parameter may be provided once with 'le' or 'lt' or 'ge' or 'gt' prefix and time component to imply a date range. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes and time component to search for medications administered within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of MedicationDispense ids.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The identity of a patient to list dispenses for. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: A date-time used to find medication dispenses. Only a single value is supported. Only 'ge' and 'gt' prefixes are supported. Ranges (multiple values) are not supported. Cannot be used together with '_lastUpdated'. If both are provided, 'date' will be ignored.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: A date-time used to search for medication dispenses which were last updated in that period. Only a single value is supported and it must include a time component. Only 'ge' and 'gt' prefixes are supported. Ranges (multiple values) are not supported. Cannot be used together with 'date'. If both are provided, 'date' will be ignored.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return. Not honored when '_id' is set.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of MedicationRequest ids.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient to return MedicationRequests for. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: intent
searchParam.documentation: The intent of the MedicationRequest.

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: The status of the MedicationRequest.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: When the resource version last changed.

searchParam.name: -timing-boundsPeriod
searchParam.documentation: The date-time within the period the medication should be given to the patient. Must be prefixed by 'ge'.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. Not honored when '_id' is set.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of NutritionOrder ids.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient to return NutritionOrders for. It is a required field if the _id field is not given.

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: The status of the NutritionOrder.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: When the resource version last changed.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. Not honored when '_id' is set.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Observation ids. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient the observation is about. It is a required field if the subject field is not given.

searchParam.name: subject
searchParam.documentation: The patient subject the observation is about. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: category
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of classifications of the type of observation.

searchParam.name: code
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of observation types.

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range from which to find observations. The 'date' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for observations at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes to search for observations within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range used to search for observations which were last updated in that period. The '_lastUpdated' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for observations at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes to search for observations within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Organization ids.

searchParam.name: identifier
searchParam.documentation: The Organization's Identifier.

searchParam.name: type
searchParam.documentation: The Organization's type.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page.

searchParam.name: name
searchParam.documentation: The Organization's name.

searchParam.name: address
searchParam.documentation: The Organization's address.

operation.name: get-cg-for-mrcu
operation.documentation: Retrieves details for a caregiver organization given a care unit organization id.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Patient ids. Either the '_id' parameter, or a combination of 'identifier', 'birthdate', 'name', 'given', 'family', 'address-postalcode', 'phone', or 'email' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: identifier
searchParam.documentation: A patient identifier. Either the '_id' parameter, or a combination of 'identifier', 'birthdate', 'name', 'given', 'family', 'address-postalcode', 'phone', or 'email' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: name
searchParam.documentation: The beginning of any name of the patient. Either the '_id' parameter, or a combination of 'identifier', 'birthdate', 'name', 'given', 'family', 'address-postalcode', 'phone', or 'email' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: given
searchParam.documentation: The beginning of the given name of the patient. Either the '_id' parameter, or a combination of 'identifier', 'birthdate', 'name', 'given', 'family', 'address-postalcode', 'phone', or 'email' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: family
searchParam.documentation: The beginning of the family name of the patient. Either the '_id' parameter, or a combination of 'identifier', 'birthdate', 'name', 'given', 'family', 'address-postalcode', 'phone', or 'email' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: address-postalcode
searchParam.documentation: The postal code of the address of the patient. Either the '_id' parameter, or a combination of 'identifier', 'birthdate', 'name', 'given', 'family', 'address-postalcode', 'phone', or 'email' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: birthdate
searchParam.documentation: The date of birth of the patient. Either the '_id' parameter, or a combination of 'identifier', 'birthdate', 'name', 'given', 'family', 'address-postalcode', 'phone', or 'email' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: phone
searchParam.documentation: The value of the phone number of the patient. Either the '_id' parameter, or a combination of 'identifier', 'birthdate', 'name', 'given', 'family', 'address-postalcode', 'phone', or 'email' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: email
searchParam.documentation: The value of the email address of the patient. Either the '_id' parameter, or a combination of 'identifier', 'birthdate', 'name', 'given', 'family', 'address-postalcode', 'phone', or 'email' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: gender
searchParam.documentation: The administrative gender of the patient. Gender may only be provided if another parameter other than '_id' is provided

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. Not honored when '_id' or 'identifier' are set.

operation.name: health-cards-issue
operation.documentation: Issues verifiable health cards for the patient.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Person ids. It is a required field if the identifier field is not given

searchParam.name: identifier
searchParam.documentation: A person's Identifier. It is a required field if the _id field is not given

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Practitioner ids. Either the '_id', 'identifier', 'name', 'active' or 'family' parameter, or a combination of 'given' and 'family' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: identifier
searchParam.documentation: A practitioner's Identifier. Either the '_id', 'identifier', 'name', 'active' or 'family' parameter, or a combination of 'given' and 'family' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: given
searchParam.documentation: The beginning of the given name of the practitioner. Either the '_id', 'identifier', 'name', 'active' or 'family' parameter, or a combination of 'given' and 'family' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: family
searchParam.documentation: The beginning of the family name of the practitioner. Either the '_id', 'identifier', 'name', 'active' or 'family' parameter, or a combination of 'given' and 'family' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: name
searchParam.documentation: The beginning of the first, last or middle name of the practitioner. Either the '_id', 'identifier', 'name', 'active' or 'family' parameter, or a combination of 'given' and 'family' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: active
searchParam.documentation: Whether the practitioner record is active. Either the '_id', 'identifier', 'name', 'active' or 'family' parameter, or a combination of 'given' and 'family' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. Not honored when '_id' is set. Either the '_id', 'identifier', 'name', 'active' or 'family' parameter, or a combination of 'given' and 'family' parameters must be provided.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Procedure ids. It is a required field if the patient or subject fields are not given

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: Search by subject - a patient. It is a required field if the _id or subject fields are not given

searchParam.name: subject
searchParam.documentation: Search by subject. It is a required field if the _id or patient fields are not given

searchParam.name: date
searchParam.documentation: A date parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes to search for procedures within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range. Must be set with patient or subject.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range used to search for procedures which were last updated in that period. The '_lastUpdated' parameter may be provided once without a prefix or time component to imply a date range or once without a prefix and with a time component to search for Procedures at a specific time. Alternately it may be provided twice with 'le', 'lt', 'ge', or 'gt' prefixes to search for procedures report within a specific range. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Provenance ids. It is a required field if the target field is not given

searchParam.name: target
searchParam.documentation: The resource(s) the Provenance is associated with. It is a required field if the _id field is not given

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Questionnaire ids.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of QuestionnaireResponse ids. It is a required field if the patient field is not given.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient that is the subject of the questionnaire response. It is a required field if the _id field is not given

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of RelatedPerson ids. It is a required field if the identifier or patient or -encounter fields are not given.

searchParam.name: identifier
searchParam.documentation: An Identifier of the RelatedPerson. It is a required field if the id or patient or -encounter fields are not given

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient this related person is related to. It is a required field if the id or identifier or -encounter fields are not given

searchParam.name: -encounter
searchParam.documentation: The encounter this related person is related to. It is a required field if the id or identifier or patient fields are not given

searchParam.name: -relationship-level
searchParam.documentation: The resource's relationship to either the patient or encounter level. Must be provided with Patient and Identifier searches.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Schedule ids. The '_id' parameter must be set.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of ServiceRequest ids.

searchParam.name: patient
searchParam.documentation: The patient to return ServiceRequests for. It is a required field if the subject or _id fields are not given.

searchParam.name: subject
searchParam.documentation: Individual or Entity the service is ordered for. It is a required field if the patient or _id fields are not given.

searchParam.name: code
searchParam.documentation: What is being requested/ordered.

searchParam.name: _lastUpdated
searchParam.documentation: When the resource version last changed.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. Not honored when '_id' is set.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Slot ids. Either the '_id' parameter or 'service-type' must be set.

searchParam.name: start
searchParam.documentation: A date or date range from which the slots are to be retrieved. The 'start' parameter is required when service-type, schedule.actor, -location is provided. When provided, must use both 'lt' and 'ge' prefixes to search for slots within a specific range. Time component should be provided for both the instances. The date and prefix pairs must create a closed range.

searchParam.name: service-type
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of appointment types that can be booked into the slot. Either the '_id' parameter or 'service-type' must be set.

searchParam.name: schedule.actor
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of schedule actors. Must be Practitioner actors.

searchParam.name: -location
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Location references.

searchParam.name: _count
searchParam.documentation: The maximum number of results to return in a page. This value should be in the range [5,200]. If no value is provided, a default page size of 50 will be used.

searchParam.name: _id
searchParam.documentation: A single or comma separated list of Specimen ids.
